capabilities: Convert pasted Zotero annotation links into Pandoc citations automatically
Resolve citation keys via Better BibTeX's local JSON-RPC API or a local .bib file
Keep zotero:// links to the specific PDF annotation inside each citation
Strip annotation links from a whole note to leave plain Pandoc citations for export
Convert selections, whole notes, and multiple annotations in one pass
extras: Desktop only, since Better BibTeX mode talks to a local port and .bib mode reads files outside the vault. The README includes troubleshooting steps, known limitations, and disclosures about local network and file access; the .bib mode matches by author surname plus year and warns about ambiguous matches.
intentEvidence: Using the excellent jpeacock29/zotero-cite-links Obsidian plugin you can click these Pandoc citations and be linked to the item in Zotero.
motivation: The author wanted the deep-link functionality of Zotero annotations for research while keeping publish-ready Pandoc citations, since the zotero-cite-links plugin only works for library items, not highlights and other annotations.
problem: Obsidian's Pandoc citation workflows work for Zotero library items, but pasted annotations arrive as Zotero links rather than citation keys, and existing click-through plugins don't cover annotations.

relations.evidence: the plugin talks to Zotero over Better BibTeX's local JSON-RPC API (item.citationkey)
Requires Zotero to be running with the Better BibTeX plugin installed.
However, this only works for library items, not highlights and other annotations. This plugin addresses that gap.

summary: Converts Zotero drag-and-drop annotation links into Pandoc-style citations that keep a deep link to the highlighted annotation in Zotero.
